```{r, warning=F, message=F}


library(dplyr)
library(magrittr)
library(randomForest)
library(tibble)

source("../../00-constants.R")






# 6.1. Import Data for RF


metadata_df_with_folds <- read.csv(
  file.path(prot_data_dir, "metadata_df_with_folds.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F
)

protein_mat <- read.csv(
  file.path(prot_data_dir, "protein_mat.csv"), 
  stringsAsFactors=F, row.names=1, check.names=F
)

lasso_fold_coefs <- read.csv(
  file.path(prot_results_dir, "lasso_fold_coefs.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F
)

lasso_fold_coefs_n3 <- read.csv(
  file.path(prot_results_dir, "lasso_fold_coefs_n3.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F
)

lasso_fold_coefs_n1 <- read.csv(
  file.path(prot_results_dir, "lasso_fold_coefs_n1.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F
)

y <- as.factor(metadata_df_with_folds$LRTI_adjudication)
metadata_df_with_folds <- as.data.frame(metadata_df_with_folds)






# 6.2. RF function


lassoRF_cv_outer_fold <- function(test_fold, selected_lasso_coefs) {
  set.seed(project_seed + test_fold)

  keep <- selected_lasso_coefs %>%
    filter(fold == test_fold) %>%
    .$protein

  X <- protein_mat[, keep, drop = FALSE]

  train <- metadata_df_with_folds$fold != test_fold

  rf <- randomForest(X[train, , drop = FALSE], y[train], ntree = ntrees)

  preds <- predict(rf, newdata = X[!train, , drop = FALSE],
             type = "prob")[, "Definite"]

  list(test_fold = test_fold, mod = rf, pred = preds)
}






# 6.3. Helper to collect predictions


collect_preds <- function(cv_list) {
  cv_list %>%
    lapply(function(x) {
      data.frame(
        sample_name = rownames(protein_mat)[
        metadata_df_with_folds$fold == x$test_fold],
        pred = x$pred)
    }) %>%
    bind_rows() %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      dplyr::select(metadata_df_with_folds, sample_name, LRTI_adjudication),
      by = "sample_name"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::relocate(LRTI_adjudication, .after = sample_name)
}






# 6.4. Run RF for all 5 classifiers


max_fold <- max(metadata_df_with_folds$fold)


# Full LASSO (lanbda.1se)
cv_lambda <- lapply(1:max_fold, function(f) lassoRF_cv_outer_fold(f, lasso_fold_coefs))

rf_preds_lambda <- collect_preds(cv_lambda)

write.csv(
  rf_preds_lambda,
  file.path(prot_results_dir, "lassoRF_preds.csv"),
  row.names=F
)


# 1 target LASSO
cv_n1 <- lapply(1:max_fold, function(f) lassoRF_cv_outer_fold(f, lasso_fold_coefs_n1))

rf_preds_n1 <- collect_preds(cv_n1)

write.csv(
  rf_preds_n1,
  file.path(prot_results_dir, "lassoRF_preds_n1.csv"),
  row.names=F
)


# 3 target LASSO
cv_n3 <- lapply(1:max_fold, function(f) lassoRF_cv_outer_fold(f, lasso_fold_coefs_n3))

rf_preds_n3 <- collect_preds(cv_n3)

write.csv(
  rf_preds_n3,
  file.path(prot_results_dir, "lassoRF_preds_n3.csv"),
  row.names=F
)


# FABP4 classifier
lasso_coefs_FABP4 <- data.frame(
  protein = rep("FABP4", max_fold),
  coef    = NA,
  fold    = 1:max_fold
)

cv_FABP4 <- lapply(1:max_fold, function(f) lassoRF_cv_outer_fold(f, lasso_coefs_FABP4))

rf_preds_FABP4 <- collect_preds(cv_FABP4)

write.csv(
  rf_preds_FABP4, 
  file.path(prot_results_dir, "lassoRF_preds_FABP4.csv"),
  row.names=F
)


# ISG15 classifier
lasso_coefs_ISG15 <- data.frame(
  protein = rep("ISG15", max_fold),
  coef    = NA,
  fold    = 1:max_fold
)

cv_ISG15 <- lapply(1:max_fold, function(f) lassoRF_cv_outer_fold(f, lasso_coefs_ISG15))

rf_preds_ISG15 <- collect_preds(cv_ISG15)

write.csv(
  rf_preds_ISG15, 
  file.path(prot_results_dir, "lassoRF_preds_ISG15.csv"),
  row.names=F
)
```
